name: Iori Minamo
source: A third-year high school girl attending the same school as [url=/c155151]Ruriiro[/url] in Tokyo. Influenced by her father, she loves music and has a talent for playing guitar and singing. During her sophomore year, she was approached by [url=/c155146]Soubi[/url], they became friends and started to shoot videos together. Apparently, since an early age, she has been hearing the "Voices of Ghosts."
